summary: Apollo Commercial Real Estate Finance filed an 8-K disclosing a September 29, 2026 termination agreement with manager ACREFI Management and a special shareholder vote. Holders approved dissolution, liquidation and winding up; 73,456,215 shares, or roughly 57.1% of outstanding common, were represented at the meeting. The manager waived any termination fee and will receive accrued unpaid compensation plus reimbursable expenses upon asset transfer to a Maryland trust or dissolution acceptance by the SDAT. Formal articles of dissolution have not yet been accepted, so the liquidation remains subject to completion mechanics and final wind-up.
